themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints surged to 21 THIS WEEK, a 310% jump from the 8-week average of 5.1 per week, suggesting a sudden deterioration in environmental sanitation across South Beach/Dongan Hills that warrants immediate investigation.
evidence: 21 unsanitary condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (310% spike)
Z-score of 10.34 indicates statistically extreme deviation from baseline
Community board has made repeated 'other expense request for DSNY' suggesting chronic sanitation funding gaps
reporting_angles: Map the specific locations of this week's 21 complaints to identify whether spike is concentrated in one area (e.g., waterfront, specific streets) or distributed
Interview DSNY about staffing levels, collection schedules, or special circumstances in the district THIS WEEK that could explain the sudden surge

themes_detail.label: Door/Window Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Door and window complaints jumped to 7 THIS WEEK, a 1020% spike from the 8-week baseline of 0.6 per week, potentially indicating storm damage, break-ins, or unsafe building conditions affecting multiple properties.
evidence: 7 door/window complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1020% spike)
Z-score of 7.44 indicates statistically significant anomaly
559 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (349 alterations) suggests possible ongoing construction impacts or structural issues
reporting_angles: Cross-reference this week's 7 door/window complaints with weather events (high winds, storms) or security incidents reported in the district
Determine if complaints cluster around construction sites or specific buildings undergoing alterations per DOB permits

themes_detail.label: Maintenance & Facility Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance or facility complaints surged to 11 THIS WEEK, a 363% increase from the 8-week average of 2.4 per week, signaling widespread deterioration of public buildings or infrastructure in the district.
evidence: 11 maintenance/facility complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (363% spike)
Z-score of 5.77 indicates strong statistical significance
Community board budget shows repeated requests for 'other park maintenance and safety' and 'move a planned capital project into budget' suggesting deferred maintenance backlog
reporting_angles: Identify which public facilities (parks, recreation centers, schools, transit hubs) generated these 11 complaints THIS WEEK
Interview Parks & Recreation and NYPD about backlogged maintenance requests and what triggered the spike in reported issues

themes_detail.label: Elevator Outages Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 5 THIS WEEK compared to a baseline of 0.5 per week (900% spike), potentially indicating widespread mechanical failures affecting residents in multi-story buildings across the district.
evidence: 5 elevator complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (900% spike)
Z-score of 9.0 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Potential connection to maintenance backlogs suggested by elevated facility complaints (11 this week)
reporting_angles: Determine if the 5 elevator complaints are concentrated in one or two buildings or scattered across multiple properties
Contact HPD and building owners to understand whether lack of maintenance access or parts shortages is driving the spike

themes_detail.label: Bus Stop Shelter Demand Surge
themes_detail.summary: Bus stop shelter placement complaints spiked to 3 LAST WEEK from a baseline of 0.1 per week (2300% spike), suggesting residents are suddenly demanding improved transit infrastructure in areas with poor coverage or shelter conditions.
evidence: 3 bus stop shelter complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% spike)
Z-score of 8.69 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Community board has standing DOT 'other expense request' suggesting transit infrastructure gaps are chronic
reporting_angles: Map which bus routes and stops generated the 3 complaints last week to identify service gaps or weather-exposed stops
Interview MTA and DOT about shelter placement plans and whether this spike reflects unmet resident demand
